headline: Herbert Smith Freehills Kramer, Khaitan & Co advise the University of Western Australia on setting up a campus in India
sum: The University of Western Australia is setting up campuses in Mumbai and Chennai in India. Herbert Smith Freehills Kramer advised The University of Western Australia on setting up their India campus.
detail: The University of Western Australia is setting up campuses in Mumbai and Chennai in India. Herbert Smith Freehills Kramer advised The University of Western Australia on setting up their India campus. The Firm advised the University on all aspects of the project, including corporate and structuring, contractual aspects, intellectual property, employment, and real estate, working with Indian counsel. The transaction was led by Siddhartha Shukla (Partner and Head of the India practice) and Lucy Curran (Partner), along with Partners Josh Lom , Nick Wright , Kathryn Coveney , Nick Pantlin , Jonathan Turnbull , and Tim Healey .
